mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_order ( order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, tracking_no VARCHAR(128) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_order(order_id, user_id, product_id, status, tracking_no) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{status}, #{trackingNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), product_id = VALUES(product_id), status = VALUES(status), tracking_no = VALUES(tracking_no)
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, user_id, product_id, status, tracking_no FROM cs_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY order_id
